scope: Proposition 6.1 (Path rectangles) of the manuscript “Universal-cover splitting for compact Kähler manifolds” (preprints/Universal-cover-splitting-for-compact-Kahler-manifolds-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 052 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 14d3e3f23539fd98), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The following assertions hold. 1. If α, β : [0, 1] → X locally follow E1- and E2-plaques, respectively, and α(0) = β(0), there is a continuous box R : [0, 1]2 → X with R(s, 0) = α(s) and R(0, t) = β(t). 2. Every continuous path γ : [0, 1] → X is the diagonal of a continuous box: R(s, s) = γ(s).
